Name half-duplex or legacy Ethernet in the stem and the key stays. «детерминизм» and «поочередный доступ (turn taking)» are not methods the module names. The shared comment explains the key only.
Six options for two keys. The shared comment restates the key; it does not say the distractors are layers, not sublayers.
«уровень приложений»: the course names OSI layer 7 «прикладной уровень» (03.05). The shared comment explains the key only.
Key true. The shared comment explains the star only, not bus, ring or mesh.

Two distractors are Layer 2 functions on real equipment. «шифрование пакетов данных»: 802.11 encrypts at the MAC (CCMP, IEEE 802.11-2020 clause 12.5.3), as does MACsec (IEEE 802.1AE). «…через создание таблицы MAC-адресов» is what a bridge does (IEEE 802.1Q clauses 8.7–8.8), and the table is taught only in module 07. Five options; the shared comment restates the keys.
Key true (6.1.1). No wrong option has a comment.

Distractor «обеспечивает форматирование данных» is defensible for Layer 2: 6.1.1 says the layer converts the data «в формат, поддерживаемый физическим уровнем», and 6.3.2 says framing gives the signals a format. Replace it with a presentation-layer statement («общее представление данных», 03.05). No wrong option has a comment.

Key true (6.2.8; 802.11 Duration field and NAV). The stem's first sentence is garbled filler («Студенты, обучающиеся по сети данных…»), and so is one option («традиционных сетевых сетях»). No wrong option has a comment. «данные немедленно передаются повторно» is false only by the backoff rule (IEEE 802.3 clause 4.2.3.2.5), which the module never states, so the comment must state it.

Pure recall beyond the allowed q03 (the pad sentence of the «Данные» row, 7.1.4). The stem calls the pad «символы-заполнители», a term the module does not use (the lecture: «пэд»). One shared comment restates the key and does not say what EtherType, the preamble and the SFD do.

Pure recall of the FCS row of 7.1.4 (the stem copies «обнаружения ошибок в кадре»), beyond q03. The shared comment states the FCS fact but not that the preamble and the SFD only synchronise the receiver.

The allowed recall item (the Type/Length row of 7.1.4); key true (IEEE 802.3 clause 3.2.6: a value of 0x0600 or more is a type). The shared comment restates the key and does not say the preamble and SFD synchronise and the FCS detects errors.

Pure recall beyond q03. The lecture gives «приготовиться к поступлению нового кадра» to «первые восемь байт», i.e. preamble and SFD together, so the SFD distractor is defensible from the text; IEEE 802.3 clauses 3.2.1–3.2.2 separate them (preamble = receiver synchronisation, SFD = marks the start of the frame). Key LLC is not supported and doubtful: no module text says LLC controls the NIC through drivers, and 06.01 says «Подуровень MAC управляет сетевым адаптером NIC», so the MAC distractor is defensible; IEEE 802.2 defines LLC as SAP multiplexing and link control, not NIC control. The stem says LLC adds «информации о приложении»; it adds the network-layer protocol identifier (7.1.2: «какой протокол сетевого уровня используется»; IEEE 802.2 DSAP/SSAP). Pure recall beyond q03; the MAC comment restates the key.

Key «использует CSMA/CD или CSMA/CA для поддержки технологии Ethernet» is false: Ethernet uses CSMA/CD (IEEE 802.3 clause 4, half duplex only); CSMA/CA is the IEEE 802.11 method (06.02: wireless LANs). The stem «Какова функция…» is singular for three keys. Pure recall beyond q03; the shared comment does not say the two distractors are LLC functions.

Pure recall of the 7.2.6 sentence beyond q02. New item replacing q04.

Five options for two keys. «коммутация с отсечкой», «с хранением и обеспечением» and «с хранением и восстановлением» are invented names (the original's made-up cut-off, store-and-supply, store-and-restore), not learner mistakes. Shared comment restates the key; recall item beyond the allowed q04.

The allowed recall item; key true (IEEE 802.3 clause 28; glossary «автосогласование»). «автоботы» is a joke and «автотюнинг» an invented feature, so auto-MDIX is the only real distractor; use features a learner confuses with it (e.g. CSMA/CD). Per-option comments pass.

Keys true (IEEE 802.3 clause 4, frame reception: a frame with a bad FCS or shorter than the minimum is discarded). Five options for two keys; drop one of the layer-1 features (auto-MDIX or auto-negotiation). Comments explain each option.

Keys true. Five options for three keys. The shared comment lists generic layer-2 fields including «флаги начала и конца кадра», which the Ethernet frame does not have (IEEE 802.3 clause 3.1.1: preamble, SFD, addresses, type, data, FCS), and does not say the IP addresses sit in the packet inside the data field.

Exhibit read: the server's gateway is the router interface 192.168.5.1 / 00-60-2F-3A-07-CC, so the key is right (7.3.5: a frame for a remote network goes to the default gateway's MAC). The shared comment does not name that address or say …-DD is the server's own (source) address, …-AA PC1's on the remote LAN and …-BB the far router's.

Key true (7.4.3: shared memory matters for asymmetric switching). «буферизация кэша уровня 1» and «буферизация фиксированной конфигурации» are invented methods, not learner mistakes; the key's «буферизация памяти с совместным доступом» is not the lecture's term («совместно используемой памяти» / «общей памяти»). The combined comment explains every option.
Keys true (fast-forward and fragment-free, 7.4.2). Five options for two keys; «коммутация CRC» and «коммутация QOS» are invented methods («QOS» should be QoS). The combined comment passes.
Key true; the combined comment explains why cut-through and both its variants are wrong (they forward before the whole frame arrives). Passes. Same tested point as q10 and q11.

Fast-forward is itself a cut-through method (7.4.2: «типичным способом сквозной коммутации»), so «сквозная коммутация» is also defensible: the category contains the key. Its comment only says so instead of why it is wrong. Replace that option or ask among the variants and store-and-forward only.

Keys true for two unconfigured modern switches (IEEE 802.3 clause 28 picks full duplex and the highest common speed; auto-MDIX on by default). Six options for three keys; «кроссового кабеля» is not the course term («перекрестный кабель», 04.04), and the first key should say «общей для обоих» to differ from the distractor. 7.4.5 states the default only in the sentence on «Cisco IOS 12.2 (18) SE», which the de-marketing pass must keep as a neutral fact.
Key true (store-and-forward checks the FCS before forwarding); the combined comment explains every option. Passes.

Key true (the FCS in the trailer carries the CRC). The shared comment restates the key and does not say the addresses and the type field serve delivery and protocol identification, not error checking. Same tested point as q06 and q11.

«использует значение CRC» also fits cut-through: a cut-through switch checks the FCS at the end of the frame to count errors, which the adaptive switching of 7.4.2 relies on; only store-and-forward checks it before forwarding and drops the frame. Say «проверяет CRC до пересылки». Same tested point as q06 and q10.

Keys true. Five options for two keys. The shared comment says an unknown frame goes «на все порты подключенных к сети устройств» without «кроме входящего» (7.3.2) and does not say why a routing table, the default gateway or destination learning is wrong. Same point as q30.

Key «подуровень LLC реализуется в ПО» is not stated in the module: 06.01 and 7.1.2 say MAC is implemented in hardware and LLC sits between the network software and the hardware. True in practice, but not taught; replace the key or add the fact to 7.1.2. The combined comment passes.
Key true. The shared comment explains auto-MDIX only; it does not say speed and duplex are set by auto-negotiation or that the forwarding method is not a port feature. Same tested point as q31.

Key true on latency (7.4.2), but HPC is not in the module and the key is conspicuously the longest option. The shared comment explains the key and the error-frame option only, not the source-MAC or the mixed-speeds options (mixed speeds need store-and-forward, which the module does not teach).

Distractor FF-FF-FF-FF-FF-FF is defensible: IEEE 802.3 clause 3.2.3 defines the broadcast address as «a distinguished, predefined multicast address» (I/G bit = 1); replace it with a unicast address. The shared comment «MAC-адреса многоадресной рассылки начинаются … с 01-00-5E» is false in general (only IPv4, RFC 1112 §6.4; IPv6 uses 33-33, RFC 2464 §7, taught in 7.2.6) and does not say the other two addresses are unicast (I/G bit 0).
Key true (IEEE 802.1D: a re-learned source refreshes the ageing timer; 7.3.2). The combined comment explains each option. Passes.
Key true (7.2.5); the combined comment covers each option. Passes.

The stem «с MAC-адресом назначения, который он не знает» is vague, and the key is false for a broadcast or a joined multicast frame, which is not the node's own address yet is accepted (7.2.3 note); the comment adds the condition the stem omits. Same tested point as q25.

Key true: a multicast frame is flooded except on the ingress port unless snooping is set (7.2.6); 01-00-5E-00-00-D9 is also the MAC of 224.0.0.217, which snooping switches flood anyway (RFC 4541 §2.1.2). The comment states the exception. Passes.
Key true (7.2.5); the combined comment covers each option. Passes.

Key «она использует метод контроля доступа CSMA/CD» is true only of half-duplex Ethernet: 7.1.3 says full-duplex switched Ethernet needs no CSMA/CD, and 10 Gb/s and faster Ethernet is full-duplex only (IEEE 802.3, since 802.3ae); qualify it («в полудуплексном режиме»). Five options; the shared comment does not say 802.5, 16 Mbit/s and the ring are Token Ring.

Key «они должны быть глобально уникальными адресами» is false for locally administered addresses (U/L bit = 1, IEEE Std 802 clause 8; randomised Wi-Fi and VM addresses, IEEE 802c), and 7.2.2 itself notes duplicates; key on the vendor-assigned address (OUI + vendor part). «маршрутизируются только внутри частной сети» is not a mistake of this module. The shared comment does not say MAC addresses are 48-bit and in the layer-2 header.

Key true (RFC 1112 §6.4: 01-00-5E plus the low 23 bits of the group). The shared comment restates the key; it does not say FF-FF-FF begins the broadcast address or that 01-5E-00 and FF-00-5E are reordered forms.

The stem lacks «одноадресный»: a broadcast or a joined multicast frame does not match the node's own address either and is accepted (7.2.3 note), so the key is false for them. The shared comment does not say why «удалит кадр из среды» (a NIC cannot remove a frame from the medium) or «перенаправит кадр на следующий узел» (a ring, not Ethernet) is wrong. Same point as q19.
Key true. The shared comment explains the switch only, not that a router decides by the IP address and a hub or repeater repeats bits with no table. Same tested point as q27.

Key true. «модем» is not a device of this module and no learner picks it. The shared comment explains only the switch and says unknown frames go «на все порты коммутатора, подключенные к одной сети» without «кроме входящего». Same point as q26.

Distractor «выполняет инкапсуляцию данных» is defensible for LLC: IEEE 802.2 wraps the packet in an LLC PDU (DSAP, SSAP, control), and 06.01 says LLC «добавляет управляющую информацию второго уровня». The comment «для связи с верхними уровнями приложений» is false (LLC serves the network layer, 7.1.2) and does not say the other options are MAC functions.

Key true for store-and-forward and fragment-free switching, but a fast-forward switch starts forwarding after the destination address and passes a collision fragment on (the reason for fragment-free, 7.4.2); name the method in the stem. Per-option comments pass.
Key true (IEEE 802.1D learning: the source address of received frames). The combined comment covers incoming vs outgoing, layer 2 vs 3 and source vs destination. Passes.

Three options are «тип …» (connector, port, switch) and only the key is a feature, so the category gives it away; the key is also by far the longest. The shared comment restates the key. Same tested point as q14.

Key true (01-00-5E: IPv4 multicast, RFC 1112 §6.4). The shared comment explains multicast only; it does not say one node is unicast and every node is broadcast (FF-FF-FF-FF-FF-FF), and the two «каждого узла…» options name the same broadcast case.

Distractor «MAC-адреса реализуются программным обеспечением» is partly true: 7.2.3 says the OS and NIC let software change the MAC address (and virtual machines get software-assigned ones), which the comment's «MAC-адреса реализованы в аппаратном обеспечении» contradicts. Replace the option; the rest of the combined comment passes.

Keys true (IEEE 802.3 clause 4.4.2: 64 and 1518 bytes untagged; 1522 with an 802.1Q tag). Five options for two keys; the stem mixes «Укажите…» with a question mark. The shared comment states both facts, which serves every numeric distractor.

Distractor «добавляет управляющую информацию к данным протокола сетевого уровня» describes the key too (a header is control information added to the packet), and «выполняет функцию программного обеспечения драйвера NIC» is defensible from 06.01 («Подуровень MAC управляет сетевым адаптером NIC»). Five options; the shared comment does not say the distractors are LLC functions.

Key true (7.4.3). The scenario (a speed report at peak traffic) has nothing to do with «Что должен знать техник…», an open «which statement is true» stem, and «рассматривает… и рассматривает» repeats. No wrong option has a comment.

The shared comment restates the key; it should say the network layer is the one that encapsulates, the data link layer receives packets from it, and the session layer sits above transport and does not hand over segments.

The stem copies the 8.1.6 sentence «отвечает за прием IP-пакета и его подготовку к транспортировке по среде передачи данных» word for word (rule 2: paraphrase). Second recall item; the shared comment restates the key and does not say the physical layer carries bits, not packets.

Third recall item (8.1.6 names fragmentation). «сериализация» is not a term of modules 01–08, so no learner picks it; shared comment restates the key. A reworked stem should say IPv4: IPv6 routers do not fragment (RFC 8200 §5; the lecture says so too).

Distractor «Общая длина»: the lecture names the field «Общий размер». Second recall item; the shared comment restates the key instead of naming the field for each job (DS priority; Identification/Flags/Fragment Offset fragments; Protocol next level).
The stem copies the 8.2.2 sentence «используется для обнаружения повреждения в заголовке IPv4»; third recall item. The shared comment restates the key and does not say what TTL, Protocol and DS do.
The stem copies «ICMP (1), TCP (6) и UDP (17)» from 8.2.2; fourth recall item. The key «Протокол» alone is capitalised. The shared comment restates the key.

Distractor «IP полагается на протоколы уровня 2 для управления ошибками передачи» is defensible: the link layer discards corrupted frames (IEEE 802.3 FCS) and IEEE 802.11 retransmits them, and the module says IPv6 dropped its header checksum because lower and upper layers check errors (8.3.4; RFC 8200). Replace it with a clearly false statement. The key is the longest option; the shared comment does not explain the media and MAC-address options.
Key true (8.3.2). The shared comment explains only the key; it should say IPv6 security, header processing and route counts are not why NAT is unneeded.

Key true (longest match, RFC 1812 §5.2.4.3; 8.5.1–8.5.2); per-option comments pass. The key repeats the stem's «IP-адресу назначения», and «наименьшим» / «наивысшим адресом следующего перехода» are mirror options.

Five options for two keys. Distractor «обнаружение ошибок» is a network-layer service the module teaches: the IPv4 Header Checksum detects header corruption (RFC 791 §3.1; 8.2.2), so the comment «Обнаружение ошибок … являются функциями канального уровня» is false for this layer. Replace that option (e.g. «управление доступом к среде») and drop to four.
